## The Work hub — 20 case studies across 4 clusters

### Cluster A — Fintech Engineering
Treated $800/mo Glassnode-class market data as a founder build-vs-buy problem — shipped equivalent intelligence at $30/mo with a live execution layer.

- CryptoPrism On-chain Analytics — BigQuery pipeline, 1B+ datapoints/day, 100+ coins
- CryptoPrism API — FastAPI microservices, p99 <50ms, on Cloud Run
- TimesFM 100-Coin Trading Bot — ML signals via Google TimesFM, automated Binance execution
- CryptoPrism News Fetcher — news sentiment pipeline feeding spot trading

### Cluster B — Enterprise Operations
Owned architecture and rollout of ERP/CRM systems real businesses run on — scope, schema, deployment, sign-off.

- PGG ERP — GST-compliant invoicing (Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL)
- PGG CRM — lead pipeline + outreach (Express + EJS + Resend + Baileys)
- Trinetry ERP — AI-native ERP with autonomous agent workflows

### Cluster C — Consumer & AI Products
Made consumer bets across edtech, cultural AI, civic tech, and gaming — chose the audience, format, and metric.

- GyanMarg — gamified edtech, spaced repetition, 60+ subjects
- Pratyaksha — 4-agent AI cognitive journaling
- Kari & Lost Shrines — 2M+ social reach, 50K+ downloads
- AI Bharatverse — interactive AI history platform

### Cluster D — Backend & Internal Tools
The invisible infrastructure — no website, but the stack runs on it.

- CryptoPrism DB — 1,000-coin daily OHLCV + 130 indicators
- Sentiment Backtest Engine — harness that sized trading viability
- Forex Data Pipeline — OANDA-backed FX data
- ForexFactory Calendar Scraper — scheduled economic-calendar scraper

## The Log — writing surface

Combines architecture notes, weekly reflections, and auto-generated weekly reviews. Filterable by kind (Thinking / Journal / Review) and tag.

### Notable architecture notes
- "Why we built a 72 PB pipeline instead of buying Glassnode" — build-vs-buy, control over schema, $30/mo vs $800/mo
- "The $427/yr cost lesson from BigQuery materialized views" — 97% cost reduction via materialized views
- "Firebase Auth vs custom JWT" — identity vs authorisation split
- "The GCP to AWS migration" — firewall, health checks, SSL idle drops
- "Self-hosting LLMs: when to buy vs run your own" — break-even at ~1,000-1,600 req/day
- "Workflows that disable themselves" — GitHub Actions 60-day auto-disable trap

### Weekly reviews (auto-generated)
The site writes its own weekly review every Friday: pulls 7 days of GitHub activity + anonymized journal themes, writes via OpenRouter, commits, deploys. Git = the work, journal = the reflection.
